name: Loslor Rudge
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Loslor Rudge keeps Dun Morogh's tinkerers supplied. His tools, parts, and munitions reach craftsmen across the snowy ridges, including gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.

sections.title: A Supplier in the Snow
sections.body: Loslor Rudge supplies engineering goods from Steelgrill's Depot, just down the road from Kharanos. His stock includes copper modulators, bronze tubing, blasting powder, and spanners. Harsh weather and scattered tinker operations keep practical parts in demand, and Loslor works to keep local gearheads supplied. The wilderness between outposts makes deliveries perilous. A courier taking a shortcut near the Grizzled Den was driven off by wendigos, leaving behind an ammunition shipment meant for Loslor's valued client, gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.

faq.answer: Loslor Rudge supplies engineering goods from Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. His shop carries tools, parts, and munitions for the region's tinkerers and craftsmen.

faq.q: What trouble does Loslor need help with?
faq.answer: Loslor needs someone to recover an ammunition shipment left in the snow. A courier bound for gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot took a shortcut near the Grizzled Den, was chased away by wendigos, and abandoned the crate.
Steelgrill's Depot is just east of Kharanos, along the main road toward Loch Modan. It is a dwarven staging ground and machine workshop.
Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith based at a camp in Dun Morogh. He relies on Loslor Rudge for fresh ammunition and mechanical components.

angles.text: Loslor stocks useful engineering supplies, including fluxes, blasting powders, tubes, and tinker's kits. His depot is a convenient stop for engineers traveling through Dun Morogh.
Like many Dun Morogh artisans, Loslor depends on reliable pack routes between scattered dwarf camps. Wendigos can disrupt the mountain trade.
